The image format to use when rendering a still. Must be one of "png", "jpeg", "pdf", "webp". Default: `"png"`.

## CLI flag

Use `--image-format` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                               | Flag                     |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                 | `--image-format <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                   | `--image-format <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)     | `--image-format <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still) | `--image-format <value>` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderStillOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/renderstilloncloudrun#imageformat)
- [`renderStillOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderstillonlambda#imageformat)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#imageformat)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setStillImageFormat('pdf');
```
